name: Luxuria Server
source:
The Hidden Server. A rumor that has been plausibly circulating within ALO.
It is said that hidden rare events exist there.
This is the story of the players who have encountered the mysterious server "Luxuria."
translation:
隐藏服务器。ALO内部流传的谣言。
据说那里隐藏着罕见的事件。
这是遇到神秘服务器“Luxuria”的玩家的故事。
